Dear STRIDE team,

I'm excited to apply for the Content & Social Media Manager role. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content strategy, SEO/GEO, and social media, I'm drawn to STRIDE's mission of building a recognizable voice and performance-driven content engine.

At Episto, I've been writing keyword-targeted content, managing on-page SEO, and building WordPress sites—skills that translate directly to owning a content calendar and producing multi-format stories. My project mirook.com shows my ability to implement structured data and GEO to improve visibility across AI search, aligning with your AI-supported content production goals.

I'm eager to bring my editorial eye, data-driven approach, and collaborative spirit to your team, working with satellite teams to adapt content locally without diluting the brand. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and ready to contribute to STRIDE's growth.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can help STRIDE tell its stories.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear STRIDE team,

When I read that STRIDE is looking for someone to own the organic content engine—someone who can turn projects and expertise into stories people want to engage with, and use data to improve—I felt a strong connection. Your emphasis on a recognizable voice and quality over volume resonates with my approach to content.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've been responsible for on-page SEO, writing keyword-targeted blog content, and building WordPress sites. This has taught me how to craft content that serves both readers and search engines, and how to measure its impact using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEMrush. I've also learned to coordinate content across channels, ensuring consistency and timeliness.

My personal project, mirook.com, allowed me to go deeper into technical SEO and GEO. I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility in AI-powered search. This experience aligns with STRIDE's goal of using AI to scale content without losing human quality—I know how to edit AI-assisted drafts to add real examples and a distinct voice.

I'm particularly excited about the opportunity to work with satellite teams across Europe. My multilingual background (English, Turkish, and learning Dutch) and my experience adapting content for different audiences would help me localize stories while maintaining STRIDE's brand identity.

I'm eager to bring my skills in content strategy, social media management, and performance analysis to STRIDE. I'm confident that my hands-on experience and data-driven mindset will contribute to building a content operation that drives growth.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can help STRIDE tell its stories.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
